turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
The rule: after he, she and it, add -s or -es to the verb.
Here is a right sentence: "She likes music." And a wrong one: "She like music." The verb needs -s after "she".

Now it is your turn. Fill the gap with one word:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
